metadata.title: Promotion and Extension of General Escape-Covering Duality Relationship
metadata.abstract: Bellman's lost-in-a-forest problem, Moser's worm problem, Lebesgue's universal covering problems, and the classical 'fits and covers' questions can be organized by a common obstruction principle: an object fits a region if some admissible group action places it in the region, whereas an escape object is one for which every placement fails to remain in the interior. In this paper, we develop a general theory of escape-covering duality for any dimension and explore several applications. For convex translation covers of all closed planar curves of Euclidean length one, we prove $ W \ge f(\sqrt3/9)+c_1>0.15545785378555,c_1=0.000009944944227372... $ Here $f(\sqrt3/9)$ is Wetzel's classical lower bound. For a rational polytopal Minkowski gauge and prescribed rational facet directions, we express universal closed-loop cover feasibility as a rational polyhedron in the facet offsets. After removing translations, minimum volume is attained at a vertex. Refining the facet directions gives explicit two-sided rational bounds for the unrestricted fixed-gauge worm constant. Four exact benchmarks recover known sharp values. The construction uses an elementary circuit--circumradius form of the established non-fitting-polygon and capacity theory. We supply its support and ledger derivation, the finite complete test family in arbitrary dimension, a cover vertex bound, and the resulting algebraicity statement. The surrounding escape--covering framework includes endpoint placement, attainment, gauge stability, and finite-to-continuum error bounds. For nonsymmetric gauges the objects are parametrized closed curves, so orientation-dependent length is retained. Through the published capacity identity, the improved Wetzel estimate gives a product volume--capacity factor below $1.023781939711102$ for every planar ellipsoidal gauge.
metadata.comment: 83 pages including formalized proofs in Lean

analysis.workSummary: 作者把森林逃逸、worm和通用覆盖组织为任意维数的escape-covering框架。对单位长度平面闭曲线的凸平移覆盖给出W>0.15545785378555的新下界，改进Wetzel界；对有理多胞体Minkowski规范及固定有理面方向，把可行性写成面偏移的有理多面体。
techniques: 非嵌入对象与覆盖的对偶
有理规范下有限完整测试族
面偏移可行多面体及顶点极值
细化面方向的双边有理误差界
analysis.breakthrough: 去平移后最小体积在可行多面体顶点取得，配合方向细化得到固定规范worm常数的双边界，并经已发表容量恒等式改进平面椭球规范的体积—容量因子。
analysis.limitations: 明确讨论单位长度闭曲线的凸平移覆盖，不能混同所有经典开放worm版本。固定有理规范/面方向的精确结论与无约束极限估计不同；非对称规范需保留曲线参数方向。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第82–83页披露GPT-5.6 sol协助证明、数值计算、语言润色及Lean4形式化证明代码。AI实际协作由这段声明确认，不是从Lean本身推断；未把某个核心覆盖路线明确归于模型，不标ideas。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.00569v1 · PDF第82–83页 AI usage disclosure

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第82–83页披露GPT-5.6 sol协助证明、数值计算、语言润色及Lean4形式化证明代码。AI实际协作由这段声明确认，不是从Lean本身推断；未把某个核心覆盖路线明确归于模型，不标ideas。

analysis.priorityReason: 凸覆盖与容量交叉较丰富，但与几何流联系较间接。
